title: Add allItems template option to InifiniteHits
body:
The infiniteHits widget is almost at feature parity with the hits widget, with the exception of the [allItems template option](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/infiniteHits.html#struct-InfiniteHitsTemplates).

This means using tabular data with infiniteHits requires either using a connector (more verbose) or, if using a front-end framework e.g. Bootstrap or Materialize) a bunch of extra markup to convert tables to an instantsearch-friendly structure.

My use case:
I'd like to use hits widget + pagination on desktop, but infinite scroll on mobile

Other use cases:
Enterprise'y customers using Tableau ([example](http://www.centralvalleycf.org/nonprofits/grants-overview/grants/))
